construction: Paired text-on/off controlled combat roles with identical bodies and inputs; outcomes are secondary to direct Shield, targeting, movement and Health-loss evidence. Not a population-strength estimate.
orientation_rule: Alternate our side by seed index, giving 16 pairs in each orientation per normal/golden case.

roles.role: Shield protects the behind carry from a lethal native Ichneumon Wasp attack.

assumptions: Controlled fixed-placement role test, not a field-strength or attainable-shop claim. No hero effects, Rings, borrowed text or held bodies.
The control removes only this neutral native mechanic from a temporary library; every combat body, other card and paired input remains identical.
